capabilities: Suggest and insert closing HTML tags while typing
Skip the cursor across whole tags
Jump to the matching opening or closing tag
extras: The README notes that automatically updating the matching tag when one is edited is coming soon, so that feature is not yet available.
problem: Obsidian's editor does not autocomplete HTML closing tags or offer navigation between opening and closing tags.
summary: HTML tag helper that autocompletes closing tags as you type and adds commands to skip over or jump between matching tags.
